topics.title: Sam’s Grammy Night Meltdown
topics.summary: During the Grammys, Sam became agitated after his manager warned him about negative publicity surrounding a planned performance and threatened to criticize the awards show. He then had an awkward encounter with a model who abruptly left following contact from his wife, creating further complications.

topics.title: The Essence of Lenny
topics.summary: During an extended discussion, hosts attempt to ‘touch the inner womb of comedy’ by seeking the essence of Lenny Bruce through a cloning-like extraction process. They discuss outlandish scenarios like freezing outside and Sam Kinness's erratic behavior, including giving away champagne and nearly causing Ed Shockey to lose $20,000.

topics.title: Howard’s Confusing Call About Haircuts
topics.summary: During a radio segment, Howard engages in an extended and confusing conversation with a caller who repeatedly expresses frustration about haircut suggestions. The call drifts into discussions of drug use, Letterman appearances, and ultimately advice to seek help for potential addiction issues.

topics.title: Security Concerns and Misunderstandings
topics.summary: A guest expresses anxieties about David Letterman’s security, proposing a Berlin Wall around his property after alleging an affair with house cleaner Meryl Marko. He discusses past conversations, referencing her comedic writing contributions and suggests Letterman is exploiting her for material while also expressing embarrassment over the situation.

topics.title: Farm Aid Broadcast - Willie Nelson Mishap
topics.summary: At Farm Aid, a mishap involving Willie Nelson results in Gloria Esteban being struck. Joe discusses steel rods and braids while callers debate farmer investment strategies and Eddie Money’s sobriety. A lengthy tangent explores agricultural failures alongside an unusual discussion of ‘wraps,’ culminating with PDQ Bach's music and commentary on Sam Tennyson.

topics.title: PDQ Bach and Valley Stream Tragedy
topics.summary: A comedian discusses a murder case involving a teenager in Valley Stream, New York, while referencing Christopher Marlowe and PDQ Bach. The family involved expresses grief but displays detachment, leading to jokes about celebrity behavior and awards, including an absurd GLAAD award.
